November · Rest, flower prep

The most important month before flowering.

  • No irrigation for bearing trees: they need mild stress
  • Let light into the canopy, look at crowded branches
  • Start checking trunks and branches for hoppers

Watch out: Unseasonal rain or clouds delay flowering.
